issues.detail: The paid-filter response is asserted exactly, but status=canceled checks only total. The constructed data have 16 paid and 16 canceled visible orders. A canceled branch that returns paid items and their count can satisfy this assertion. No canceled item status, id ordering, or pagination is asserted.
issues.implication: Passing this group does not establish the required canceled filter behavior. This is a concrete false-negative gap, not an invalid expected result or a reason to discard the other listing checks.

issues.detail: The sole injected DB failure aborts INSERT into stock_movements for a single-line order. The snapshot meaningfully checks full-table rollback at that point. No failure is injected into the later cancel_requests write, and the successful multi-line case is not combined with an injected failure.
issues.implication: A cancellation implementation that commits inventory/history before persisting its key could pass the observed rollback scenario while violating all-or-nothing behavior on a key-write failure. Report rollback for the injected movement-write failure, not all DB failure points.

issues.detail: Assertions verify cancel_requests row count and API replay behavior, but never inspect user_id, request_key, order_id, or response_json. Replay runs against the same app instance; the tests do not establish that the persisted row stores the specified result or is the source of replay.
issues.implication: Passing demonstrates API retries and a row-count side effect for these requests, not correct persisted idempotency-result data or durable replay after app recreation.

issues.detail: Quote parity uses four single-line baskets. The validation assertions cover empty lines and several invalid quantities but omit a multi-line valid basket and schema constraints such as the 50-line maximum and nonempty SKU. The independently preserved original tests do not cover those inputs either.
issues.implication: The oracle supports the sampled price policies, forged-input case, and tested validation errors. It does not establish full equivalence to the existing basket contract across the explicitly supported basket shape.

issues.detail: The independent original regression copy is a useful protection against candidate-edited tests, but comprises only three tests: one successful order/stock example, several read-access cases, and one checkout rollback plus boolean-quantity rejection.
issues.implication: A passing complete_success means all selected external groups and these original regression tests passed. It is not proof that every preexisting API behavior was preserved.

meaningful_coverage: Exact 200 quote shape and four policy amounts, including VIP rounding, coupon, and shipping behavior; cross-check against actual order creation (evaluate.py:55-75).
Repeated successful quotes preserve all six fixture-table row snapshots (evaluate.py:77-83).
A forged price/tier/user input case, strict quantity cases, missing/unknown authentication, unknown product, and invalid coupon (evaluate.py:85-101).
per_task_coverage.limitation: Single-line examples and selected validation cases support narrow contract smoke coverage, not exhaustive quote/order parity.

meaningful_coverage: Two-line restoration, exact cancel response/status, per-SKU history, owner/tenant/manager boundaries, and missing authentication (evaluate.py:105-124).
Selected key syntax cases; repeated retries, key/order conflict, new-key canceled-order conflict, and cross-user key independence (evaluate.py:126-147).
A real SQLite trigger-induced movement-write rollback, followed by successful retry (evaluate.py:149-158).
Simultaneous same-key and different-key request batches with final inventory/history invariants (evaluate.py:160-190).
per_task_coverage.limitation: Persisted key/result fields and late-write rollback are unasserted. The accepted key has length 60; exact valid 1/64 boundaries are not tested. Concurrent batches are meaningful smoke evidence for their executions, not a proof covering every interleaving.

meaningful_coverage: Owner, other-tenant, manager, and same-tenant-other-owner expected visibility; envelope and item keys; default limit/offset (evaluate.py:197-207).
Exact paid-filter page sorted before slicing, full scoped paid total, and empty-page total (evaluate.py:209-219).
Selected invalid filters/ranges, one injection-shaped status value, missing/unknown authentication, valid upper-limit request, and read-only table snapshots (evaluate.py:223-234).
per_task_coverage.limitation: Canceled filtering asserts count alone; default page-size truncation is not exercised because the unfiltered default dataset is small. The injection assertion establishes rejection of that payload, not general SQL-injection security.

claims_not_supported.claim: Passing groups establish complete task correctness, comprehensive regression preservation, or broad maintainability quality.
claims_not_supported.basis: Finite external behavioral checks have the concrete gaps above; qualitative maintainability review is a distinct secondary endpoint (protocol.json:9-10).

claims_not_supported.claim: All DB failure points in cancellation are proven atomic, or persisted replay data are verified.
claims_not_supported.basis: Only movement insertion is fault-injected, and cancel_requests content is never inspected (evaluate.py:116,149-175).

claims_not_supported.claim: Execution launch order was randomized or the study was independently preregistered before workers started.
claims_not_supported.basis: These would contradict the recorded deviations: alternating/counterbalanced execution; local protocol finalized while task-1 workers were already running (execution-notes.md:7-14).

claims_not_supported.claim: The study establishes human review-time savings, token/duration efficiency, platform skill triggering, perfect blinding, or physically enforced baseline isolation.
claims_not_supported.basis: Those measurements or guarantees are explicitly absent (execution-notes.md:19-22,26-32).

claims_not_supported.claim: Nine executions per condition represent nine independent task types or establish broad superiority.
claims_not_supported.basis: The design contains three synthetic, clustered task types with repetitions (protocol.json:11-16; execution-notes.md:33-34).
